preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 50.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 to form a tree.
The starting vertex s must be a valid vertex number.
The number of criminals m must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xj <= n and xj != s for xj in criminals)
preconditions.description: Each criminal's vertex must be a valid vertex number and different from the starting vertex s.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Terrorists win' if not can_catch_all else stdout == str(time_needed)
postconditions.description: If the policeman cannot catch all criminals, output 'Terrorists win'. Otherwise, output the time needed to catch all criminals.
The time needed to catch all criminals must be a non-negative integer.
